authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: Create one cinematic editorial photograph of Gaslamp Fantasy: visible magic operating within a gaslit nineteenth-century city. The main subject is a fictional woman guided by the supplied appearance reference. Use the supplied image only for her facial likeness and her short straight dark bob with wispy fringe. She is a municipal lamplight inspector at the end of a rainstorm, working beside an open iron utility cabinet on a narrow stone canal bridge at night. She wears a fitted oxblood wool work jacket, cream open-collar shirt and dark high-waisted trousers, her calm concentration and rain-bright face carrying a subtle personal magnetism. Her left hand steadies the cabinet door by its outer edge while her right hand grips and turns one brass stopcock at waist height; her forearms approach from separate sides without crossing, and both hands and the pipe connection are clearly visible. A pale translucent spirit flows from the exposed brass gas pipe, its upper body gathering into a small humanlike silhouette beside her shoulder while its lower trail stays visibly continuous with the pipe. The streetlamp directly connected to the cabinet has just ignited blue-white, casting the spirit's glow onto her face and wet fingertips; the next two streetlamps remain warm amber. Her eyes follow the newly lit lamp with a restrained, relieved half-smile. Behind her, soot-dark brick houses and a horse-drawn night carriage recede along the canal; a single covered pedestrian pauses beneath an amber lamp. Photograph the woman from mid-thigh upward at three-quarter angle, with her face, both hands, the open cabinet and the connected streetlamp all readable in one frame. The camera is just below her eye level, a natural 50mm photographic perspective; moderate depth of field keeps the important pipe-to-spirit-to-lamp relation legible. Blue-white magical light, amber gaslight and deep wet burgundy form a restrained palette. Tactile wool, oxidized brass, damp stone and softly imperfect skin; grounded photographic textures, practical shadow and coherent reflections. The ordinary city has accepted this small supernatural maintenance task as part of its night work.
